note.p: This is not Basil Montagu's mother, who was murdered in 1779 by James Hackman, nor is it the first Mrs Basil Montagu, Caroline Matilda Want, whom Montagu married in 1790, leading to him being cut off by his father (John Montagu, the 4th Earl of Sandwich), and who died in 1793. Nor is it Basil Montagu's second wife, Laura Rush (m. 1801, d. 1806). Rather, it seems to be the wife of Robert Montagu (1763-1830), one of the 5 illegitimate children Basil Montagu's father had with Martha Rae. Ed Pope comments: Admiral Robert Montagu 1763-1830 will PCC 1830, elder brother of Basil Montagu and son of 4th Earl of Sandwich by Martha Ray, married 10.5.1786 at St Margaret's Westminster, Mary Elizabeth dau of Edward L'Epine merchant of Gt George St will PCC 1788. Her husband was probably absent on naval service at the time.
